dataset.name: HPV-negative head and neck carcinoma (CPTAC-GDC, 2025)
dataset.description: Independent CPTAC head and neck cancer cohort with GDC-derived bulk RNA-seq TPM and GDC survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC primary HPV-negative head and neck carcinoma; context-specific and not population-matched to the full TCGA-HNSC cohort.

metadata.source_data_system: NCI GDC via the cBioPortal public API and GDC survival API
metadata.redistribution_note: The cohort is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, but raw matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TPM expression and survival are joined by patient submitter ID. GDC supplies censoring follow-up that is absent from most living-patient rows in the cBioPortal clinical table.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The cBioPortal GDC profile supplies non-negative TPM values. TCGA-TRACE applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Initial diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
